items.t: Engine stalls or shuts off while driving
items.job: Diagnose stalling; replace throttle body, sensor or TIPM as needed
items.note: Owners report about $360-$1,200 depending on the part found.

items.t: Power module (TIPM) failure causes no-start and random electrical faults
items.job: Replace and program TIPM power module

items.t: Heater blows cold on the passenger side
items.job: Flush cooling system or replace heater core
items.note: A flush is the low end; a heater core job means removing the dash and runs about $1,100-$1,900.

items.t: Shifter stuck in Park
items.job: Repair or replace shifter park-lock assembly
items.note: Owners report about $200-$490. Ask whether campaign K16 applies.

items.t: Transmission stuck in one gear (limp mode)
items.job: Diagnose limp mode; repair wiring or replace transmission control module
items.note: Can climb to a transmission rebuild if internal damage is found.

items.t: Automatic transmission slipping, harsh shifts or failure
items.job: Rebuild or replace automatic transmission

items.t: Alternator rattles and fails
items.job: Replace alternator

items.t: Check engine light for intake manifold runner valve (P2004)
items.job: Replace intake manifold and reprogram engine computer

items.t: Left cylinder head failure and misfires
items.job: Replace left cylinder head
items.note: Often covered by the 10-year/150,000-mile extended warranty; check with a dealer first.

items.t: Ticking from worn rocker arms
items.job: Replace rocker arms and lifters

items.t: Coolant leak from water pump or thermostat housing
items.job: Replace water pump or thermostat housing

items.t: Brakes squeal or grind on a newer car
items.job: Replace front and rear pads, resurface or replace rotors

items.t: No start from anti-theft key system
items.job: Diagnose immobilizer and reprogram or replace key module

items.t: Airbags and seat belt pretensioners may not work (recall)
items.job: Replace airbag control module

items.t: Active head restraints may not deploy (recall)
items.job: Active head restraint recall repair

items.t: Steering column rivet may be missing (recall)
items.job: Inspect and repair steering column

items.t: Loss of oil pressure can stall the engine (recall)
items.job: Oil pressure recall repair

items.t: Fuel tank valve can break, causing a leak or stall (recall)
items.job: Replace fuel tank control valve assembly

items.t: Power steering hose can leak onto hot engine parts (recall)
items.job: Inspect and replace power steering pressure hose

items.t: Brake booster pushrod clip may come off (recall)
items.job: Inspect and install brake booster clip

items.t: Corroded tire-pressure wiring can cause stalling or no-start (recall)
items.job: Seal tire pressure monitor wiring

items.t: Cooling fan connector can short and cause a fire (recall)
items.job: Replace fan motor and add wiring overlay

items.t: Front door latch cable can let a door open (recall)
items.job: Front door latch cable recall repair
